title: Six Short Conversations
instructions: You will hear six short conversations or announcements. For each question (1–6), choose the correct answer (A–C).

questions.q: Which platform does the airport train leave from now?
questions.why: «It leaves from platform five now» — avval 2-platformadan ketardi, endi 5-dan.

questions.q: What does Tom want to do?
questions.why: U soat 3 o'rniga soat 5 da uchrashishni so'rayapti.

questions.q: What will the woman have as her main course?
questions.why: Baliq tugagan, qo'y go'shtini yoqtirmaydi — tovuqni tanladi.

questions.q: What is the problem with the jacket?
questions.why: «It's just too small for me» — rangi yoqadi, shikastlanmagan.

questions.q: Why will the library close early today?
questions.why: «all staff members have to attend a meeting».

questions.q: What will the friends do on Sunday?
questions.why: Shanba kuni muzey, yakshanba kuni piknik.

script.t: Listening. Part one. You will hear six short recordings. For each question, choose the correct answer. Now you will hear the first recording.
Question one.
Excuse me, does the train to the airport still leave from platform two?
Not any more. It used to, but they changed it last week. It leaves from platform five now. Platform nine is for the trains to the north.
Platform five. Thank you very much!
No problem. You had better hurry, though. It leaves in ten minutes.
Question two.
Hi Anna, it's Tom. I'm afraid I can't make it at three o'clock, because I have a dentist appointment. Could we meet at five instead? Call me back when you get this message. Bye for now.
Question three.
Are you ready to order, madam?
Yes. I'll have the tomato soup to start, and then the grilled fish.
I'm very sorry, but the fish is finished for today. We have chicken or lamb.
Hmm. I don't really like lamb. I'll take the chicken, please.
Question four.
Hello, I'd like to return this jacket, please.
Of course. Is there something wrong with it?
No, it isn't damaged, and I like the colour. It's just too small for me.
Do you have the receipt?
I'm afraid not, but I paid by card.
That's fine. I can find it on the computer. Would you like the same jacket in a larger size?
Yes, please.
Question five.

Attention, please. This is an announcement for all library users. Today the library will close at six o'clock instead of eight, because all of the staff have to attend a meeting. Books can still be returned using the box outside the main door. The library will open as usual tomorrow at nine. Thank you.
Question six.
Have you seen the weather forecast for the weekend?
Yes. It's going to rain on Saturday, so I think we should visit the new museum.
Good idea. And what about Sunday?
Sunny and warm. We could take some sandwiches and have a picnic by the river.
Perfect. Let's do that.
That is the end of part one.
